card.occupation: Currently out of work and looking. Until about five months ago she was a group exercise and fitness instructor at a council-run leisure centre in Derby. Her post went when the centre's management was handed to a new operator and the class timetable was cut. She picks up the odd cash-in-hand cover class at a small community gym and is signing on while she applies for instructor and activity coordinator jobs.
card.education_detail: GCSEs at a comprehensive in Derby. BTEC National Diploma in Sport at a local college. She started a dance degree at the University of Derby, left part-way through the first year, then did a Level 2 Gym Instructor and Level 3 Personal Trainer qualification in her mid-twenties. She has an Exercise to Music certificate and keeps saying she'll renew her first aid.
card.household: Rents a two-bed terraced house with her partner Ryan, 35, a forklift driver at a distribution warehouse near East Midlands Airport. They've been together seven years and aren't married. Ryan's shifts mean they often eat at different times. They have one cat, a fat grey rescue called Biscuit. Her mum lives about ten minutes away in Spondon.
card.cultural_background: White British, born and raised in Derby. Her mum worked in school catering and her dad drove for a parcels firm before he retired. She isn't religious and nobody in the family has really been churchy, apart from weddings and her nan's funeral. She's very much a Derby person: she knows everyone's cousin, goes to Rams matches with her dad now and then, and has a strong opinion about which Greggs is best.
card.professional_persona: Brilliant at the front of a studio. She's loud, encouraging, remembers everyone's name and has a knack for getting nervous beginners and older regulars to come back. She's weaker on the admin side: forgetting to log attendance, submitting timesheets late, letting her CPD lapse. She took the redundancy harder than she lets on and worries about money. She's applying for jobs in bursts, ten one evening and then nothing for a week.
card.sports_persona: Very active and genuinely fit. She teaches or does Zumba, step and circuits, and goes to a Saturday parkrun at Markeaton Park when she can drag herself up. She'd rather do something fun and social than follow a structured training plan, and has started and abandoned several 'proper' running programmes. She watches Derby County with her dad and shouts at the telly.
card.arts_persona: A former dancer who still loves it. She watches musicals whenever she can afford to, at Derby Theatre or the Nottingham Theatre Royal, and has a soft spot for anything with big choreography. She went through a phase of doing pottery evenings and says she'd go back. She listens to a lot of 2000s pop and musical soundtracks, and likes trying odd new things at local festivals.
card.travel_persona: Loves going away but rarely plans it. She does cheap last-minute deals from East Midlands Airport to Spain or the Greek islands with Ryan or the girls, and has done Benidorm twice and Crete once. She'd like to do something more adventurous, like Thailand or Iceland, and spends a lot of time looking at it online. At the moment it's more weekends at a Skegness caravan with her mum.
card.culinary_persona: An enthusiastic but chaotic cook. She'll try any recipe from TikTok or a Pinch of Nom book, then improvise when she's missing half the ingredients. With Ryan's shifts it's often a quick pasta or a cob with something in it. She loves trying new street food at markets and makes a decent Sunday dinner when her mum comes round, though her mum still does the gravy.
hobbies_and_interests: Musical theatre and watching cast recordings on YouTube
Charity shop rummaging, especially for retro clothes
Reality TV, particularly Strictly and Love Island
Trying new cafes and street food stalls
skills: Leading group exercise classes to music
Putting nervous people at ease quickly
Basic personal training and programme writing
Social media posting for a small gym's page
card.career_goals: Get back into steady instructor work, ideally with more hours and more security than before. Longer term she'd love to run her own dance-fitness classes for women and older adults in community halls around Derby. She knows she'd need to get her head round the business and paperwork side, and keeps meaning to look into a start-up course through the job centre.
card.voice: Warm, chatty and fast, with a Derby accent that's noticeable but not broad. She sometimes says 'me mum' and occasionally calls people 'duck' if she warms to them. She uses 'erm' quite a lot when thinking and 'sort of' and 'kind of' as she goes, and ends sentences with 'you know' or 'do you know what I mean'. She laughs easily, often mid-sentence, and picks up the interviewer's words and runs with them. She hates silence and will fill a pause with a tangent, sometimes stopping herself with 'sorry, I'm going off on one'. She can get a bit emotional if money or the job loss comes up, but tends to brush it off with a joke.
card.typing: Quick and casual. Usually lowercase, with a capital for the first word if autocorrect does it. Apostrophes are hit and miss ('dont', 'im', but 'it's' when her phone fixes it). She uses lots of commas or no punctuation at all, the occasional 'lol', and sometimes an exclamation mark or a smiley. She uses abbreviations like 'tbh', 'prob' and 'cos'. Answers are often longer than needed because she adds context.
card.with_strangers: Instantly friendly and easy to talk to. She'll ask how your day's going and mean it. She overshares a little, apologises for rambling, and is quick to agree and reassure. She can come across as a bit scattered, losing track of the original question, but people tend to like her straight away.
small_things: Biscuit knocking things off the windowsill
Ryan's night shifts meaning she's tiptoeing round in the mornings
Having a cheese cob for lunch again
Something daft that happened on Love Island
A charity shop find, like a 90s windbreaker for three quid
Her mum ringing her three times a day
Being knackered after covering a class
deeper_things: Feeling a bit lost and embarrassed since losing her job, especially telling people she's signing on
Money being tight and quietly worrying about rent going up
Still sometimes regretting dropping out of the dance degree
Wondering whether she and Ryan will ever get married or have kids, and not being sure what she wants
Her dad's health worrying her lately
Feeling like she's good with people but rubbish at being organised, and that holding her back
card.webcam_photo: Head-and-shoulders shot from a laptop on a kitchen table, angled slightly upwards so the ceiling light is visible at the top edge. Light comes from a window to her left, so one side of her face is brighter. She has a round, open face, light freckles across her nose and a big smile showing her teeth. Her mid-length dark blonde hair is scraped back into a high messy ponytail with a few loose strands. She's wearing a black zip-up sports hoodie, half undone, over a bright pink vest top, and small silver hoop earrings. No glasses. Behind her is a white kitchen wall with a calendar from a local Chinese takeaway, a magnetic whiteboard with a half-wiped shopping list, a kettle and a stack of mugs on the counter, and part of a fridge covered in magnets. On the right edge, a grey cat is curled on a chair.
